target.title: Apply Claw workspace files
target.body:
## Summary

- applies Claw `workspaceFile` and `persona` entries when `claws apply --yes` or `claws feed apply --yes` is used
- adds `--workspace <dir>` so workspace/persona writes are scoped to an explicit workspace root instead of the manifest location
- writes files through OpenClaw's fs-safe root API, rejects source/target path escapes, and refuses to overwrite unmanaged user content
- records Claw-owned workspace file refs in shared SQLite state alongside the artifact refs introduced by #101755

## Stack

- RFC: openclaw/rfcs#27
- Depends on validation PR: #101328
- Depends on mutating apply PR1: #101755

## Behavior

This PR keeps artifact installation itself out of scope. It combines PR1's artifact provenance refs with the first real workspace mutation:

- package-like entries still record Claw artifact refs only
- workspace/persona entries copy manifest-local sources into the selected workspace root
- automation entries remain preview-only for the next PR track
- existing identical workspace files are accepted and recorded as `unchanged`
- existing different workspace files fail closed unless OpenClaw has a matching prior managed hash for the same Claw/target
- managed workspace refs are scoped by canonical workspace root and target, reject cross-Claw target adoption, preserve original `appliedAtMs`, and clean stale refs when entries disappear
- `appliedWorkspaceFiles` counts files actually written (`created`/`updated`), while `workspaceFiles` still returns the recorded refs including `unchanged`

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts`
- `git diff --check && node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --base origin/user/giodl/claws-pr3-feed-plan` returned no blocking findings at head `a9dfef12328`.
- `pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit --pretty false` is still blocked by unrelated `src/secrets/config-io.ts` TS4058 outside this PR diff, same as #101755.

## Real behavior proof

Command:

```bash
STATE=$(mktemp -d /tmp/openclaw-claws-pr4-state-XXXXXX)
WORKSPACE=$(mktemp -d /tmp/openclaw-claws-pr4-workspace-XXXXXX)
OPENCLAW_DISABLE_BUNDLED_PLUGINS=1 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="$STATE" \
  node --import tsx src/entry.ts claws apply \
  src/claws/fixtures/incident-response.claw.json \
  --yes --workspace "$WORKSPACE" --json
```

Observed current-head JSON summary:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "openclaw.clawApplyResult.v1",
  "dryRun": false,
  "mutationAllowed": true,
  "summary": {
    "totalEntries": 5,
    "recordedArtifactRefs": 3,
    "appliedWorkspaceFiles": 1,
    "previewOnlyEntries": 1,
    "skippedUnsupported": 0,
    "blockedEntries": 0,
    "provenanceRecords": 4
  }
}
```

Workspace output contained `SOUL.md` with the fixture runbook content. SQLite contained three `claw_artifact_refs` rows (`incident-triage-skill`, `pager-duty-plugin`, `statuspage-mcp`) and one `claw_workspace_file_refs` row (`runbook`, operation `created`).
